name: Gunstock Club
body:
A slightly bent war club with both a spike and a crushing end. It is debated if it was patterned after the back of a musket or if the gunstock club developed separately. When wielding it the user must decide if they are using the spiked tip (piercing damage) or the club end (bludgeoning damage).
